turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My front door sticks every time it rains. I have to shove it with my shoulder.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The wood is probably swelling. You could tighten the hinges first or plane down the edge. Where would you like to start?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Sam something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just that the bus was late again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam, is it just me or is the bus really late today?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's not just you. The sign says twelve minutes now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It said five minutes when we got here.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably the roadwork on the main street again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we just walk? It's like fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: In this rain? Let's give it five more minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine. But if it's not here by then, I'm walking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Any decision on the sticking door, hinges or planing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think I'll just plane it. It's been like this for years.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Mark where it rubs, take the door off its hinges, and shave off only a little at a time.
